answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 156174 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it permissible to do masah over hijab when performing wudhu because sometimes women are in market, where it is so difficult to pen the hijab? Question: Is it permissible to do masah over hijab when performing wudhu because sometimes women are in market, where it is so difficult to pen the hijab? Answer ID: 156174 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 159/102/SD=2/1439) No, it is not lawful to do masah over Hijab. The fardh of masah shall not be fulfilled. She should do masah behind some partition. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
